posts.text: You can’t judge a company like this on a quarter-to-quarter basis. The meat is in the concall. But talking about the results, this is what strikes me as remarkable: image 940×368 121 KB Goods that were sold for Rs.170.51crore had a material cost of Rs.42.55 - 33.96 = 8.59 crore. Incredible for a manufacturing company. Talk of “value addition”! Disc: Holding
